messages:
oliver: Quick heads up 4: search is returning the old /docs/dedicated/scaling as canonical but the page now has frontmatter canonical_url: /docs/dedicated/scale-up (so a bunch of inbound links end up 404ing on the fragment). Anyone on docs own the scaling guide?
mia: that page is in the runtime runbook set. We changed the slug during the restructure but forgot to add a redirect. I can open a PR to fix frontmatter or add a doclinks redirect.
oliver: broken example: the toast link on https://help.redwood/internal/team-setup points to /docs/dedicated/scaling#autoscaler which 404s.
tyler: preference is to add a shortlink redirect entry in doclinks.yaml so external refs keep working. Also add a canonical_url in frontmatter that matches the redirect target.
search-bot: alert: search-indexer detected duplicate titles for dedicated scaling pages; reindex will not resolve until canonical_url matches redirect rules.
mia: plan: 1) add doclinks.yaml mapping from /docs/dedicated/scaling -> /docs/dedicated/scale-up 2) update frontmatter canonical_url to "/docs/dedicated/scale-up" 3) run `npm run docs:link-check` and `python scripts/update_search_index.py --dry-run` locally.
mia: branch docs/fix/dedicated-canonical-redirect created, small PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1166 - includes redirect + canonical fix + tiny changelog note.
ci-bot: build/links 3 queued
ci-bot: build/links 3 passed
rachel: tiny ask: add `owner: eng-runtime` to frontmatter so alerts route to the right team. Also add a single-line test in docs/tests/test_redirects.py referencing the old path.
mia: added owner and test, squashed fixes. PR updated.
tyler: LGTM, will merge after CI green. Nice catch.
oliver: thanks! I'll ping product to update the internal toast link to the new canonical once this lands. :+1:
